_note: The settings glyph, redrawn. The shipped ui/gear.png was a 1172x1163 / 2 MB source that never
went through the guide's icon path (512 master -> 256 runtime, art-style-guide.md 0 and 5): the
settings tile draws it at ~56px, a 21x minification with mipmaps OFF, so the GPU point-sampled it
into a hard aliased staircase and averaged its paper fibre away. It also baked a directional
shadow and a traced outline into the artwork, which the guide's shadow-boundary rule forbids and
which held the runtime glyph pool off the artwork's own edge.
Regenerated at 512 with the modelling that survives phone size: one flat cream top face, ONE
same-hue darker plane reading as the card's cut THICKNESS down the lower-right of every tooth and
inside the hole, a broad lit plane upper-left, a fine warm cut edge, 2-4% paper fibre, and no
despill: the generator keyed its own background out and left 8 low-alpha magenta-tinted pixels on
the outer edge, which is a non-zero count on the guide's section-8 cut gate. The shared despill
pass clears them; measured back to 0.
